name: eco
description: ECO connects ChatGPT and Codex to the current lnwjud-compatible Windows agent runtime through headless MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Use ECO headless MCP with your Windows projects
interface.longDescription: ECO routes ChatGPT and Codex workflows through a headless stdio MCP entrypoint to the shared lnwjud runtime. Files, Git, processes, Windows automation, browser control, Office actions, WSL, recovery, tasks, and other local capabilities remain on the user's Windows machine under the shared runtime's workspace, permission, and safety boundaries; lnwjud Desktop/Electron is not required.
defaultPrompt: Use ECO to list workspaces, show Git status for the active project, and summarize the top-level tree without changes.
Use ECO to inspect this project, make the requested code change, run the narrow relevant tests, and show the Git diff.
Use ECO to observe the Windows target first, then perform only the requested UI action within current permissions.
